ESPERON Series

Industrial Crossover & Maintenance Platforms

ESPERON series platforms provide safe transit over pipelines, machinery, conveyors, and other factory obstructions. Engineered from structural 6061-T6 aluminum, these units feature standard 45-degree climbing angles, deep non-slip treads, and continuous guardrails.

  • Modularity: Pre-assembled steps and platform modules bolt together on site in hours.
  • High Stability: Heavy-duty ground stabilizer plates require zero anchors in standard setups.
  • Safe Work Space: Integrated 1100mm high safety guardrails with 150mm kick plates (toeboards).

ProTUBE Series

Professional Aluminum Rolling Towers

ProTUBE mobile scaffolding towers represent the ultimate safety standard in high-altitude work. Designed with thick wall-grooved aluminum tubing, quick-snap diagonal braces, and heavy-duty locking casters, ProTUBE towers are easily deployed and relocated by two operators.

  • Double Lock Casters: Polyurethane-covered casters prevent floor damage and lock both rotation and rolling.
  • Plywood Platform: Non-slip, weather-resistant plywood platform with integrated trapdoor.
  • Quick Assembly: Snap-fit joint claws require no tools for bracing configuration.
Inquire ProTUBE Scaffold

SPRINGO & RUTON Series

Rolling Safety Warehouse Ladders

SPRINGO ladders feature spring-loaded casters that automatically retract when weight is applied, locking the rubber-buffered steel legs firmly to the floor. RUTON ladders utilize mechanical locking stabilizer bars for extended heavy stock picking.

  • Auto-Lock Casters: Retracts instantly under 25kg load, ensuring zero-slip climbs.
  • Extra Wide Platform: Large 600x600mm work deck with handrails on three sides.
  • Grooved Steps: 80mm deep aluminum grooved steps prevent slipping.
